plugin_desc: Used to collect key indicators of Redis performance and resource utilization.
name: Redis

metrics.name: redis_uptime
metrics.description: Duration of Redis service continuous operation, reflecting service stability and availability, continuous positive values indicate normal operation

metrics.name: redis_used_memory
metrics.description: Total memory currently occupied by Redis instance, including data storage and internal data structures, monitoring prevents service interruption due to memory overflow

metrics.name: redis_maxmemory
metrics.description: Configured maximum memory usage limit for Redis instance, combined with memory usage to calculate utilization rate, guides capacity planning and expansion decisions

metrics.name: redis_mem_fragmentation_ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of memory allocated by allocator to memory reported by OS, reflects degree of memory fragmentation, high ratio may affect memory allocation efficiency

metrics.name: redis_instantaneous_ops_per_sec
metrics.description: Real-time frequency of command operations processed by Redis instance, directly reflects current service load level, used to identify traffic peaks and abnormal fluctuations

metrics.name: redis_total_commands_processed_rate
metrics.description: Average rate of commands processed by Redis instance, measures service processing capacity, rate decline may indicate performance bottlenecks or insufficient resources

metrics.name: redis_keyspace_hits_rate
metrics.description: Frequency of successful key space hits, reflects cache hit efficiency, high frequency indicates effective cache strategy and high data access efficiency

metrics.name: redis_keyspace_misses_rate
metrics.description: Frequency of key space misses, reflects cache miss situation, high frequency may require optimization of cache strategy or increase in cache capacity

metrics.name: redis_keyspace_hitrate
metrics.description: Proportion of key space hit operations to total operations, core performance metric, high hit rate indicates efficient cache system operation and good data access performance

metrics.name: redis_total_net_input_bytes_rate
metrics.description: Average rate of network data received by Redis instance, monitors input traffic changes, abnormal increase may indicate attacks or business logic changes

metrics.name: redis_total_net_output_bytes_rate
metrics.description: Average rate of network data sent by Redis instance, monitors output traffic changes, analyzes response data volume trends combined with business metrics

metrics.name: redis_clients
metrics.description: Number of currently active client connections, reflects service concurrent processing capacity, approaching max connections configuration may affect new connection establishment

metrics.name: redis_blocked_clients
metrics.description: Number of clients in blocked waiting state, non-zero value indicates performance bottlenecks or resource contention, requires further investigation

metrics.name: redis_expired_keys_rate
metrics.description: Frequency of keys automatically deleted due to expiration time, reflects data lifecycle management, abnormal frequency requires attention

metrics.name: redis_evicted_keys_rate
metrics.description: Frequency of keys actively evicted due to memory limits, reflects memory pressure, non-zero frequency indicates memory usage has reached limit

metrics.name: redis_rejected_connections_rate
metrics.description: Frequency of connection requests rejected due to reaching max connections, reflects connection resource tension, non-zero frequency requires consideration of expansion

metrics.name: redis_connected_slaves
metrics.description: Number of replicas currently connected to this instance, used to check whether the primary-replica topology is intact

metrics.name: redis_master_link_status
metrics.description: Health of the link from this replica to its primary. Healthy means replication is flowing; a broken link means the replica cannot receive updates

metrics.name: redis_repl_backlog_active
metrics.description: Whether the replication backlog is enabled, so replicas can catch up after a brief disconnect

metrics.name: redis_repl_backlog_size
metrics.description: Capacity of the replication backlog. If too small, disconnected replicas may be unable to catch up incrementally

metrics.name: redis_repl_backlog_histlen
metrics.description: Amount of data currently held in the replication backlog

metrics.name: redis_master_repl_offset
metrics.description: Current replication progress on the primary, used to compare how far replicas have caught up

metrics.name: redis_slave_repl_offset
metrics.description: Current replication progress already applied on the replica

metrics.name: redis_mem_replication_backlog
metrics.description: Memory occupied by the replication backlog

metrics.name: redis_cluster_enabled
metrics.description: Whether this instance runs in cluster mode

metrics.name: redis_cluster_connections
metrics.description: Number of connections among cluster nodes
